title: Structure highline names and dual H/L highlights
description:
Structure Mode can mark a manhole as having a highline (upper/lower at the same spot). Check “Has a highline” when naming a node; the second name defaults to the main name plus H (e.g. MH-83 → MH-83H), and you can override it. On the map, the main name stays large with the highline name under it at half size.

Auto-highlight lines that touch a highline node draw as a two-tone green pair (mint upper / deeper green lower) with H and L letters on the strokes so upper vs lower is obvious at a glance.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, place a structure with Has a highline checked, confirm dual labels, then run Auto Highlight on a segment that uses that node.
changeLog: Add Has a highline checkbox on the structure name modal with default name + H.
Persist hasHighline / highlineName on structure nodes (create, edit, reload).
Show main structure name large and highline name half-size under it.
Index highline names for Plan Sync / auto-highlight matching.
Render highline auto-highlights as dual mint/green strokes with H and L labels.
